$comment: Pinned release public keys (ed25519, hex) by key id. A release needs valid signatures from BOTH: ci-1 = GCP KMS basalmind-pod-release/pod-release-ci v1 (only the release workflow on main can use it); hw-1 = Jonah's YubiKey 5C NFC, PIV slot 9c, generated on the device (PIN + touch). Two distinct keys, one person (option 1, 2026-11-21). Pinned 2026-11-24 after a dry run of release 0.0.1 verified [ci-1, hw-1]. Must stay identical to core BasalTribe/basaltribe/pod_release_pins.json. To replace a lost key, change both files by PR. Test keys live only under test/.
